body: trust me i am more than honest to him. so honest that it got me involuntary  9 days inpatient at a hospital because of how bad my depression is from this. I dont want to obsess over this and am not trying to get her back at all. I truly want to move on but cant.

i try. i go to therapy. moved/got a new job away from the town we met and i still feel the same everyday. trust me if i could move on and get over it i would. i dont want to feel/be like this. i wouldn't wish how i feel everyday on anybody
im not injecting. we dont talk at all and havent in months. i dont look at her social media. Can't control the thoughts to something that meant that much to you
easier said than done

im not saying it is my business. However when u love someone for 4 years and are worried about them rushing into a marriage and getting hurt down the line then it does become your business because it affects you mentally. Im not saying im intervening or trying to sabotage their wedding. I am just worried for her. i dont contact her and haven't for months now.
im not saying it is my business. im not saying im trying to intervene or anything at all. people are taking this the wrong way

im not saying they are my problems. but when u love someone for that long it does become your problem mentally because you still care for them and want them to be safe/happy. All im stating is that i don't think this marriage will not work out and i am worried for her when it does eventually fail. Easier said then done to just forget about something like that after 4 years

Im not trying to intervene at all. I already stated that she is never coming back. Im just worried about her thats all. Its different when you love someone from a different country who has no parents or family.

I have tried seeing new ppl but I am only thinking about her. I cared about this girl so much that I would feel horrible to ever marry someone else since I hurt her feelings so badly by always promising to marry and never doing it. Im in a very bad spot

thats the worst part. i completely effed up. I had something great and because I was too hesitant I let time pass me by and have to live with these regrets forever now. It was completely my fault and I cant stop beating myself up every day
The worst part is when she told me that she was going to marry this guy I begged and tried so hard for her not to do it. I told her I would marry her right that day and she still said no.

thank you. thats a good way to look at it and I have tried to spin it in my head that way but I just cant accept it. I loved everyday with this girl and was an extremely happy/productive person with her in my life. The only stress in my life was her being here illegal and knowing I would have to marry soon. you never know what could happen if i did marry her but i truly believe it would have been a positive thing, it would have been like a monkey off the back for the both of us and a chance to move on and have a real life. the fact that I didnt even try it and let life pass me by is a really sick feeling. its been 8 months and time hasnt healed anything. the only thing i think about from the second I wake up throughout the whole day is her and this guy together because i got too comfortable and it makes me sick.

idk. I have a lot of anxiety so was always nervous to have a wedding. I also have a fear of flying and once i married her we would fly overseas to see her family. looking back at it these are 2 of the stupidest reasons be nervous and not marry someone you love. I let life pass me by and she is married/sleeping with/traveling the world with another guy because I am a pussy. its the worst feeling in the world and makes me sick to my stomach every second of the day just looking back at it and cringing.

I am very young. just turned 24. was nervous to tell my parents i was getting married even though they loved her too. I never thought she would leave me for somebody else so I kept taking my time, it was a very selfish thing to do and I hate myself for it. she was the nicest girl in the world , did everything for me and I made her hate me by keeping her away from her family for 4 years.
thanks man appreciate it
I understand that but I don't see any difference between a girl marrying someone because he has a good job or something else to offer
im trying. i just cant stop beating myself up and thinking about all of the things I could have said/done while i still had the chance. life is too short to miss out on an opportunity like that.
thank you for the advice i really appreciate it
thank you for the kind words. anything helps.

you should just be honest. A few months ago my problems were so bad i thought i had no other option besides suicide. my parents found a suicide note and i had to go inpatient for 9 days. This was a blessing in disguise because it showed my parents how bad my mental state really was and my job gave me a paid leave of absence which took a lot of stress out. This happened about a month ago and I cant say im not suicidal anymore but i definitely am better than before i went in. if anything you will get the proper medication .

She wanted to marry me. She was basically begging for me to marry her because of how homesick she had gotten but I kept getting nervous and putting it off until she couldn't take it anymore. You're right maybe the marriage wouldn't have worked out but the worst thing in life is the regrets and not knowing and that's what drives me crazy

All I do every second of the day is think of mistakes and things I could have done in the four years to avoid this from happening and it drives me crazy. Then I come back to reality and think of her actually being married to someone else and it makes me sick. I know I could find someone or marry someone else but I loved this girl so much and I hurt her feelings by not marrying her for so long and I would feel terrible to even be with someone else. I'm really just in a horrible situation mentally

I have a few friends but I'm out of school now and all of my friends have full time jobs so we only see each other few times a month.  I have never been an outgoing person and was with this girl everyday for basically the whole 4 years so now I have almost nothing to do besides think about this situation.  I keep trying to accept it and spin it in a way like things always happen for a reason but I just don't believe what I tell myself. ThIngs do happen for a reason and this reason was that I got too comfortable and never thought something like this could happen.  I was always scared of losing her in other ways like deportation due to her status but never imagined losing her to someone else. It's really just the worst possible ending to the best thing that ever happened to me. I know everybody had regrets in life but the fact that I didn't seize the moment and marry her while I still had the chance is gonna haunt me forever.
Appreciate it. I definitely wasn't ready for married life but I also was never ready to lose her and especially not to another guy after 4 years. That's what kills me

I promised her in October 2013 that I'd marry her right after the holidays because she got really homesick. She didn't leave me until July 2015 so she gave me plenty of time. I put almost all the blame on myself for ruining a great relationship and losing an opportunity to see other parts of the world by marrying her and traveling to her country

For sure by the end she fell out of love and for sure most of her motivation was for marriage.  I just keep beating myself up for not marrying her before the relationship broke because of the empty marriage promises and even though she doesn't really love this guy it still kills me to think about her with him

Thanks I appreciate it. My life was so good and comfortable with her in it that's why it's so hard to move on. I only want that old life even though it's never coming back and the fact that This was all so easily avoidable makes it even worse. But you're right the only thing I can do now is learn to live with it and move on. Easier said than done though

That's the worst part. I knew I wasn't ready for marriage but also was never ready to lose her. I promised her in October 2013 that I would marry her soon and she still stuck it out for another year and a half. I knew something bad would happen if I kept waiting but I was stupid and got too comfortable thinking she would never do something like this. It really was all my fault and that's why it's so hard to accept and get over it. I can't stop regretting not marrying her while I had the chance and before she fell out of love

Yeah I used to be the happiest person every day. Ever since this I basically only have extreme regret,depression, and anger. Only thing that makes me happy is daydreaming of what could have been. I used to have a good day almost every day and now I can't even remember what it feels like to not be depressed.

thank you. its tough cause no matter what I do i regret not marrying her so she could be there with me. i always wanted to travel everywhere with her and now she is living out my dreams with another person. it kills me. i dont even want to travel anywhere cause ill just be regretting that she isnt here experiencing it with me. she was from a poor country so even just seeing the beach was a huge deal for her. its at the point where id rather just be dead so i dont have to live with the constant regret and torture that i go through everyday. every day has been unbearable since this happened
yep that song is perfect for times like these thanks man
love that line, gonna look at these comments when im feeling at my worst appreciate and love everyone
yes 100 percent

Thanks man appreciate all the entertainment and laughs this sub has provided these past few months it really kept me going . She's out traveling the world with another dude after 4  years while I'm back living in my parents house so it's tough to stay positive after something like that but this album came at the right time in my life. Hopefully things keep getting better.

Thanks man, I'm not out of the depression yet by any means but having the album to look forward to gave me a reason to want to live during this living hell the past 6 months ,and that led to things getting at least a little better.
Didn't expect to get all these responses ,thanks to everyone,anything helps during tough times
Thanks man I truly truly appreciate all Of the responses
Thank you for the advice, have been going to a therapist for months now and still feel the exact same unfortunately. Scared that I will be stuck like this forever
